description: Peak graphics memory of the Idol stage (image to latent to point cloud) with models built on the CPU and run one stage at a time, compared with the previous construction.
device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24,564 MiB), Windows 11, PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128

model.file: local experimental Q8 build, Idol-experimental-Q8_0-octree-Q8_0-nov05.gguf (967 MB class)
model.note: Not the published Idol-Q8_0.gguf (sha256 1f6875979bac8c8aecacf0c698662b7c63ff54ae1b6d7c06755297a05607e983); the tensor layout and size are of the same class, so memory should be close, but this was not measured with the published file.

encoders: original DINOv3 (facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m) and FLUX.2 autoencoder, bfloat16

inputs.decoder: native CPU decoder for the command-line runs; GPU decoders for the session run

method: PyTorch's CUDA allocator was limited with torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction; peak allocated and reserved memory are PyTorch's counters. Whole-process dedicated graphics memory, which includes the CUDA context, is the Windows 'GPU Process Memory' counter for the process, sampled roughly every 0.4 to 1 second, so brief peaks can be missed. One run per row.

previous_construction.note: make_pipeline puts the denoiser, background remover and both encoders on the GPU while building, before staging parks anything.

runs.result: out of memory while building (2.77 GiB allocated)
out of memory while building (2.52 GiB allocated)
out of memory while moving DINOv3 to the GPU (2.35 GiB allocated)
out of memory in the autoencoder or denoiser stage (1.83 GiB allocated, 21 s in)

session.description: IdolSession built under staged_construction(), two generations in a row, GPU decoders

output_comparison.previous_construction_cap_3584_vs_cap_61: latents differ (relative L2 difference 2.3e-2) and the point clouds differ
output_comparison.note: In this test the previous construction's result depended on how tight the memory cap was. The staged construction gave the same result at both caps it completed at. One image and one seed, so this does not establish identical output in general.

limits: The floor for the staged construction is between a 2.0 and a 2.5 GiB allocator cap for this image and model; it was not searched more finely.
These are Idol-stage figures only. The image generator was measured separately (iris-memory-budget.json). A prompt-to-3D run on an actual 4 GB card was not performed.
Staged inference moves models between host and device memory each request, so it needs host memory for all of them and is slower than resident inference.
